_comment: Alternative to the PnP script: a SharePoint SITE SCRIPT that provisions the PercyConversations list. Upload with: Add-SPOSiteScript -Title 'Percy Conversations' -Content (Get-Content ./percyconversations.sitescript.json -Raw); then attach to a site design or apply via Invoke-SPOSiteDesign. Multi-line columns are plain text (RichText FALSE) via addSPFieldXml.

subactions.description: Percy assistant conversation turns (one row per message).

subactions.schemaXml: <Field Type='Text' DisplayName='ConversationId' Name='ConversationId' StaticName='ConversationId' Indexed='TRUE' MaxLength='255' />
<Field Type='Note' DisplayName='Body' Name='Body' StaticName='Body' RichText='FALSE' RichTextMode='Compatible' NumLines='6' />
<Field Type='Note' DisplayName='Reply' Name='Reply' StaticName='Reply' RichText='FALSE' RichTextMode='Compatible' NumLines='6' />
<Field Type='Text' DisplayName='Status' Name='Status' StaticName='Status' Indexed='TRUE' MaxLength='32' />
<Field Type='Note' DisplayName='ErrorMessage' Name='ErrorMessage' StaticName='ErrorMessage' RichText='FALSE' RichTextMode='Compatible' NumLines='6' />
